name: cable rope one arm hammer preacher curl
description: A one-arm hammer preacher curl with a rope on a cable. It targets the brachialis and the biceps on one side.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and place a preacher bench in front of it.
Sit at the bench with one upper arm on the pad and hold the rope with a neutral grip, thumb up.
Keep your upper arm on the pad and curl the rope toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly to a straight arm, finish the reps, then switch arms.
